caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed mainly of two colors: light brown and dark brown. The central part is a smoothly curved, elongated, and slightly contoured dark brown wooden piece with a natural wood grain texture. Four lighter-colored, U-shaped wooden loops are attached symmetrically to the underside of the main wooden piece, two on each side. Two vertical wooden pegs, also in the lighter shade, emerge upward from the top of the main wooden piece, each secured with a thin wire or metal ring. In the center, on the upper surface, there is a small black metal component, possibly a fastening mechanism, with a matching black circular element hanging directly beneath the wooden piece. The drawing is rendered on a plain, off-white background, with the artist’s name, "Rose Campbell," written in small uppercase letters at the lower right corner.
title: Yoke for Oxen
